subject: english
stem:
The new signs show drivers where to slow down. Bright lines help walkers cross, and lights make the corner easy to see. Fewer people now feel unsafe there.
Which statement best covers the whole paragraph?
options: No road can ever be dangerous again
Road changes made the corner safer
The signs tell drivers to slow

optionRationales.reason: No road can ever be dangerous again：原文只說該路口改善。
Walkers prefer dark corners：與 bright lines、lights 和 safer 結果相反。
Road changes made the corner safer：標誌、線條與燈光都導向安全改善。
The signs tell drivers to slow：只抓到第一項設施。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「多句以重複、同義或因果方式回到的共同概念」可推出 Road changes made the corner safer；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Road changes made the corner safer 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
